description: Linchpin side-chain reach geometry, and figure showing the failed occlusion control alongside the rotamer-independent E2 interface comparison
code:
import numpy as np, requests, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def parse_pdb(t):
    at=[]
    for ln in t.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            try: xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
            except ValueError: continue
            el=(ln[76:78].strip() or ln[12:16].strip()[0])
            if el.upper()=="H": continue
            at.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),resn=ln[17:20].strip(),ch=ln[21],
                           resi=int(ln[22:26]),xyz=xyz,bfac=float(ln[60:66] or 0),el=el.upper()))
    return at
ap4=parse_pdb(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4AP4.pdb",timeout=200).text)
# how far can each side chain reach from CB?
def reach(at,ch,resi,tips):
    d={a["name"]:a["xyz"] for a in at if a["ch"]==ch and a["resi"]==resi}
    return {t:float(np.linalg.norm(d[t]-d["CB"])) for t in tips if t in d and "CB" in d}
print("RNF4 Arg181 CB->tip:",{k:round(v,2) for k,v in reach(ap4,"A",181,["NE","CZ","NH1","NH2"]).items()})
lys=[(a["ch"],a["resi"]) for a in ap4 if a["resn"]=="LYS" and a["name"]=="NZ"]
ext=[reach(ap4,c,r,["NZ"]).get("NZ") for c,r in lys]; ext=[e for e in ext if e]
print(f"Lys CB->NZ across {len(ext)} lysines in 4AP4: mean {np.mean(ext):.2f}, max {np.max(ext):.2f} A")

occ=pd.DataFrame([["LONRF1 RING1",49,7.6,"two-RING protein"],["LONRF1 RING2",2,2.8,"two-RING protein"],
                  ["LONRF2 RING",4,3.0,"active ligase"],["LONRF3 RING1",75,12.7,"two-RING protein"],
                  ["LONRF3 RING2",3,3.0,"two-RING protein"],["BIRC7 RING",92,10.7,"active ligase (control)"]],
                 columns=["ring","occluding_res","PAE","note"])
pos=["L1+2","L2+1","L6+3","L6+4","L7+1"]
vals={"RNF4 (crystal)":[18,6,17,8,25],"LONRF1 RING1":[10,8,4,28,29],"LONRF1 RING2":[14,14,15,6,30],
      "LONRF2 RING":[15,13,17,12,29],"LONRF3 RING2":[16,14,16,10,31],"BIRC7":[21,13,1,0,31]}
labs={"RNF4 (crystal)":["I138","M140","D169","S170","P178"],"LONRF1 RING1":["G125","R127","R149","E150","R156"],
      "LONRF1 RING2":["L481","M483","R505","C506","P514"],"LONRF2 RING":["L451","M453","R475","C476","P484"],
      "LONRF3 RING2":["L469","M471","R493","C494","P502"],"BIRC7":["V254","L256","G278","L279","P283"]}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.2))
cols={"active ligase":"#2b7a3d","active ligase (control)":"#2b7a3d","two-RING protein":"#3b6ea5"}
for _,r in occ.iterrows():
    ax[0].scatter(r.PAE,r.occluding_res,s=140,c=cols[r.note],edgecolor="k",zorder=3)
    ax[0].annotate(r.ring,(r.PAE,r.occluding_res),xytext=(6,6),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=9)
ax[0].axvspan(6,14,color="#ffd9d9",zorder=0)
ax[0].text(10,55,"inter-domain packing\nnot confidently predicted\n(PAE > 6 A)",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#8b2020")
ax[0].set_xlabel("mean PAE between RING core and occluding residues (A)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("residues clashing with docked E2~Ub (< 3 A)")
ax[0].set_title("Steric occlusion of the E2 site fails its positive control:\nBIRC7, a known ligase, scores as occluded")
ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)

x=np.arange(len(pos)); w=0.14
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(vals.items()):
    c="#999999" if k=="RNF4 (crystal)" else ("#c23b22" if k=="LONRF1 RING1" else "#3b6ea5")
    b=ax[1].bar(x+(i-2.5)*w,v,w,label=k,color=c,edgecolor="k",lw=.4)
    for xx,yy,lb in zip(x+(i-2.5)*w,v,labs[k]):
        ax[1].text(xx,yy+0.6,lb,ha="center",va="bottom",rotation=90,fontsize=6.5)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(pos)
ax[1].set_ylabel("backbone + CB atoms within 5 A of docked E2")
ax[1].set_xlabel("position in the RING zinc-ligand register")
ax[1].set_title("E2 interface measured with rotamer-independent atoms:\nGly125 is the only position with no side chain to offer")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,ncol=2); ax[1].set_ylim(0,42); ax[1].grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
occ.to_csv("artifacts/LONRF_occlusion_control.csv",index=False)
